title: Require canonical source-record event dates
problem: validate_records accepts compact and ISO-week event_date strings even though records retain those noncanonical values and the related activity-period contract requires canonical YYYY-MM-DD. Non-string event dates can escape as TypeError.
acceptance_criteria: A supplied non-None event_date must be a string representing a real calendar date exactly in canonical YYYY-MM-DD format; compact and ISO-week forms are rejected.
Invalid types and invalid/noncanonical dates raise ValueError, including bool, numbers, lists and dictionaries; preserve absent and None event_date.
Preserve valid leap dates, by-ID return values, input immutability, other record/plan contracts, and all existing tests; add concise standard-library unittest tests.
exclusions: Only the described behavior and one new regression-test file. No dependency, UI, network, existing-test, or unrelated source changes.
